title: 'Quantum gravity' appears out of nowhere around 1972 as a blocking mechanism

tellings.quote: if you look and you do a Google engram search there is basically no hits on quantum gravity until around 1972.

plain: The phrase "quantum gravity" is said to have appeared out of nowhere around 1972, as a way of blocking real progress on gravity. A mathematician named Eric Weinstein makes the case using Google Ngram, a tool that counts how often words appear in books over time. He says it shows "basically no hits on quantum gravity until around 1972." If he is right, physicists may have been steered away from gravity research that mattered.
